title: Intraday return periodicity (Heston, Korajczyk and Sadka 2010) on 26 futures, hourly; nested
rule: per root and ET hour-of-day bar: t = mean / (sd / sqrt(n)) of that hour's roll-safe returns over the previous N trading days (strictly before today); hold sign(t) for that hour's bar when |t| > k; size 0.10 / (hourly vol x sqrt(24 x 252)) / 26 per root (60-day hourly vol); cost = cost_frac per unit turnover
selection: best on 2010-06..2022-12 (daily-summed P&L); enters only if > 0.3
judgement: book = Gen146 executable book (10 sleeves) + entrant, Sharpe-weighted on 2010-22; ONE evaluation 2023-26 vs 0.815
